arb.text: The Dragonsoul Knight rides to rescue his clanmates in Jund but finds them floating in the air, their mortal souls seeping out of their bodies, and he flees rather than charge when Zarratha's army harvests their souls as fuel.
Fleeing away from Grixis, he crosses Naya, where he sees white mana in the Nacatl and elves, and then Bant, where he begins to have night-terrors of a dragon bursting from his body.
He rides through Esper and into Grixis, completing his circuit, where he recognizes the world that spawned Zarratha and finds his dead clanmates forming the lich's front lines.
Using mana he never understood, he unleashes dragonfire, Zarratha perishes, and he cremates his friends and returns home to found a new warrior-clan.
